topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: City's got a way of shrinking down to the size of a postage stamp when you least expect it. Ran into Susie, or so she says her name is now, in this dive on the corner where the neon never quite lights up the cracks. I remember her from the chat rooms, way back when I still believed in the digital Sanctuaries. She was telling me about the cat she rescued, how the city can be a tough place for a stray. Funny how the world works; you spend half your life talking to someone through a screen, and then one day, you're ducking rain under the same awning. I listened, sipped my coffee, and filed it under 'unexpected.' Didn't say much, just let the silence fill up the space between us. Stranger things in this life, but not many.
